title: Kayak Hotels Search Scraper
description: Search Kayak hotel listings with names, star levels, review scores, amenities, provider prices, and property links. Batch location IDs and compare future stays.

batch.title: KAYAK location IDs
batch.description: City, airport, or property location IDs to search for hotel offers.
batch.valueDescription: Location Id used to run this search.

schema.description: KAYAK location identifier for the city, airport, or property search.
Type of KAYAK location identifier, such as a city, airport, or hotel. Accepted values: city, airport, hotel.
Hotel check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
Hotel check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format, after check-in.
Number of adult travelers included in the search.
Age of one child in the hotel search, from 0 to 17.
Sort order for returned search results. Accepted values: rank_a, price_a, review_a.

relativeDateDefaults.description: When omitted, check-in is set to 30 days from today.
When omitted, check-out is set to two days after check-in.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Search Kayak hotels by location and stay dates. Export names, star levels, review scores, amenities, provider prices, and links by destination market.
storeCopy.intro: Search Kayak for hotel listings with names, star levels, review scores, amenities, provider prices, and property links. Batch location IDs for future stays.
useCases: Travel planners can compare hotel choices and booking providers by destination.
Hospitality analysts can benchmark ratings, star levels, and amenities.
Travel agencies can build property shortlists for upcoming trips.
howToUse: Add a KAYAK location ID to each entry in `locations`.
Set stay dates and guest options or use the relative date defaults.
Use `maxResults` to cap saved property offers.

faqs.question: What is a KAYAK location ID?
faqs.answer: It is the location code used by KAYAK for a city, airport, or property. Copy it from a supported search URL or a previous result.
